(Junior) Sales Manager, Inside Sales (f/m/d) in Stuttgart

Join eccenca, a provider of enterprise knowledge graph technology. Help customers adopt linked data, RDF, and semantic data products.

The Role

Build the sales pipeline for knowledge graph solutions.

Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (f/m/d) — Leipzig (preferred) or Remote

Operate the cloud foundation for eccenca Corporate Memory, a semantic knowledge graph platform using linked data.

Your Role

Build Kubernetes infrastructure and delivery workflows for the knowledge graph product.
